title: RapidX  (Decentralized Paypal)
tagline: Paypal Killer - Revolutionizing the cross border payments through web3.0 payment rails
description:
This project aims to help small and medium-sized eCommerce merchants expand their business globally in a fair and competitive manner by providing alternative to centralized PayPal. 

It aims to reduce the fees by 100x and archives this through decentralization and community-sourced liquidity. The project involves tokenization of fiat, putting tokens on polygon blockchain, and using an adaptive AMM to facilitate cross-currency swaps at the lowest possible fees. Fees are further reduced for on and off ramp by using Open banking APIs instead of traditional on/off ramps. 

AMM involves single currency pools, which are self-balancing through dynamic fees and cashback.

The protocol thus generates real yield to the liquidity providers i.e. community
how_its_made:
Blockchain Tech Stack
ERC20 Token standard for Fiat tokens, LP Tokens, and Governance Tokens
Rapid Smart Contract to add liquidity, withdraw liquidity, and transfer function to do cross-border Transactions.
Events emitted for add liquidity, withdraw liquidity, and transfer function.
Front end tech stack
NextJs
Tailwind.css
Ethers.js
